name: SlideFillButton
description: Outline button whose solid fill slides in from a chosen edge on hover or keyboard focus while the label inverts color, with configurable fill color and timing.
a11yNotes: Semantic <button type="button">; the fill layer is aria-hidden and decorative. The fill also plays on :focus-visible keyboard focus (not on mouse focus), touch taps do not leave a sticky fill, and prefers-reduced-motion makes the fill and color change instant.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Button label (ignored when children are provided).

propsApi.name: direction
propsApi.description: Edge the fill slides in from.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the button.
